name: agent-governance-layer-dashboard
description: Phase 3 dashboard: a React + TypeScript ops/compliance view over the FastAPI read API in app/api.py. Separate from, and additive to, the server-rendered Jinja UI in app/templates (which stays as the primary workflow UI - submitting requests, working the escalation queue). This is the reviewer-facing visual layer: the full decision/audit trail, flagged vs clean filtering, and the policy override rate trend.
